name: Synchronizacja
source:
Enter the world of Synchronicity and discover its secrets! Follow one of the two available stories. Together with the characters, search for answers in a peculiar world. Find out what's behind it all... And try to break the infinite time loop.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1847900/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
进入《Synchronicity》的世界，发掘它的秘密！从两条故事中选择一条，与角色们一同在这个奇特世界中寻找答案。查明这一切的背后究竟是什么……并设法打破无尽的时间循环。

[摘自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1847900/]Steam[/url]]
